title: City of Dreams Manila wins sixth Asia’s Leading Casino Resort Award, retains title at World Travel Awards 2026
summary: City of Dreams Manila earned prestigious honors for the sixth time as Asia’s Leading Casino Resort and retained its title as the Philippines’ Leading Casino Resort at the 2026 World Travel Awards…

blocks.text: City of Dreams Manila earned prestigious honors for the sixth time as Asia’s Leading Casino Resort and retained its title as the Philippines’ Leading Casino Resort at the 2026 World Travel Awards Asia, Oceania & Indian Ocean Gala Ceremony held at CROSSROADS Maldives. The annual international awards program, which recognizes excellence across the travel, tourism and hospitality industries, also named Nobu Hotel Manila, one of the luxury integrated resort’s three hotels, as the Philippines’ Leading Lifestyle Hotel. Graham Cooke, Founder of World Travel Awards, said the 2026 winners represent the very best in tourism excellence and congratulated awardees for raising the […]...
